answer: A Stripe Atlas formation makes each extra identity pay $500 to incorporate a Delaware LLC; a farm running N fakes pays N×$500 and cannot share it because the IRS hands one EIN to one company and never reissues it. Two seats filing the same EIN trip the duplicate rule at filing number two, and the IRS cancels both companies' seats on the spot. Names like Lotus Trading, Tundra Freight or Jetty Marine each cost their own $500, plus $100 a year for the agent, $400 Delaware tax — a 500-seat farm files 500 formations, $250,000, before one fake earns.
